subject: economics
title: Balance of Payments, Exchange Rates and International Competitiveness

questions.question: Define the term 'current account of the balance of payments'. (2 marks)
An economy records a current account balance of −$25bn and a capital account balance of $2bn. Calculate the balance on its financial account. (2 marks)
Explain how an expenditure-reducing policy improves a deficit on the current account. (4 marks)
Analyse the effect of a rise in relative interest rates on the exchange rate of a floating currency. (6 marks)
Draw a demand and supply diagram for a currency to show the effect of a rise in demand for that economy's exports. (4 marks)

An economy's currency falls from $0.50 to $0.40. Price elasticity of demand for its exports is 0.9 and for its imports 0.5. Exports and imports were each 600bn naro. Calculate the new trade balance in domestic currency. (4 marks)
Examine the case for a government defending its exchange rate by raising interest rates rather than by selling foreign currency reserves. (8 marks)
Discuss the factors that determine an economy's international competitiveness. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that reducing the value of its currency is the most effective way for an economy to improve its international competitiveness. (20 marks)
